groups.name: env.printer
groups.description: Configuration properties for the Environment Printer starter.

properties.name: env.printer.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the environment printer functionality. When disabled, no environment variables will be printed at startup and the endpoint will not be available.

properties.name: env.printer.endpoint-enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the HTTP endpoint for environment variables. Disabled by default to avoid exposing configuration metadata.

properties.name: env.printer.project-only
properties.description: Filter to show only environment variables actually used in the project. When enabled, scans configuration files and optionally configured compiled classes, and displays only those variables.

properties.name: env.printer.show-values
properties.description: Show environment variable values instead of names only. Use with care because values may contain secrets.

properties.name: env.printer.scan-compiled-classes
properties.description: Scan configured application packages in compiled classes for @Value and System.getenv references.

properties.name: env.printer.scan-packages
properties.description: Application package prefixes to scan when compiled-class scanning is enabled.
